unit.why: A brief first-person memorate quoted from the author's book Otzar ha-Hayyim: after finishing his homilies he was shown in a dream that they had been accepted in the Garden of Eden before the righteous. It is a minimal event, not just a saying.
unit.boundary_note: one of a numbered series of excerpts (טו) from the tsaddik's writings; previous and next divisions are similar self-testimonies

stories.end_quote: לפני הצדיקים ב"ה וב"ש חי וקיים עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The author of Otzar ha-Hayyim records that on finishing his homilies on 25 Marheshvan he was shown in a night dream that they had been received in the Garden of Eden before the tsaddikim.
